$comment: Lamo Stories' own model list (docs/CONTRACTS.md §45.25, ADR-77). Separate from config/models.json, which is Clip Factory's and is never read by Lamo Stories. Terraform builds the Lamo Stories agent's bedrock:InvokeModel grants from this file. 'profile' is the inference profile the agent calls; 'regions' are that profile's destination Regions (for IAM; '*' for a global profile). 'efforts' are the output_config.effort levels the model accepts (empty: no effort setting, the model runs at its own level). 'pricing' is Anthropic's own list price for reference (source anthropic_list, checked 2026-11-21); Amazon Bedrock bills its own price, which can differ, so the owner may type Bedrock's in Lamo Stories › Settings › AI (source owner). null where no price is known. The owner's 'Sable 5.2 / Sable 5.1' are the Claude Fable 5.2 / 5.1 models below.
